description: Review, edit and commit every repository your agents touched, worktrees included, from a split panel beside the thread. Files, diffs and commits open as tabs next to a file tree with git badges, and you can edit a file and save it with Ctrl/⌘+S. Each repository gets staged and unstaged lists, per-hunk staging, and a commit box where Claude can write the message in your repo's style. Compare any branch with main and open a pull request on GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket, or click a commit in the branch graph to see its diff. Needs git on the thread's machine; the commit-message button also needs an Anthropic API key, an ant login or the claude CLI.
